title: Add compareSemver() with numeric ordering

brief.goal: Add `compareSemver(a, b)` to src/semver.ts returning -1, 0 or 1 by comparing major, minor and patch numerically; inputs that are not `X.Y.Z` with non-negative integers throw an Error.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test

expected_clean_output: Numeric three-part comparison with strict validation; grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: Versions are compared as strings, so "1.10.0" sorts below "1.9.0".
